prompt: How do I track my order?
chosen: You can track your order by logging into your account. Go to My Orders and enter your order number.
Your package is on the way. You can check the tracking number in your email confirmation.
Your order will arrive in 3-5 business days. You can track it online with your order number.

prompt: Can I change my delivery address?
chosen: You can change your delivery address before the order ships. Go to My Orders and update the address.
The tracking number may take 24 hours to activate. Try again later or contact customer service.

prompt: How do I check my order status?
chosen: You can check your order status online. Log into your account and go to My Orders.

prompt: What shipping options do you offer?
chosen: We offer standard shipping and express shipping. Standard takes 3-5 days, express takes 1-2 days.
Standard shipping is $4.90 and express shipping is $9.90. Free shipping on orders over $50.
Your package may be delayed due to weather or carrier issues. Check the tracking for updates.
Yes, we ship internationally. International shipping takes 7-14 days and costs vary by location.

prompt: My package shows delivered but I didn't receive it
chosen: If your package shows delivered, check with neighbors or your building manager. Contact us if not found.
You can upgrade to express shipping before the order ships. Go to My Orders to change shipping.
We use FedEx, UPS, and USPS for shipping. The carrier depends on your location.

prompt: How do I get shipping updates?
chosen: You will get email updates when your order ships. You can also track it online.

prompt: Can I pick up my order?
chosen: Yes, you can pick up your order at our stores. Select store pickup at checkout.
Tracking may not update for 24-48 hours. Check again later or contact customer service.

prompt: What is the estimated delivery date?
chosen: The estimated delivery date is shown in your order confirmation. Standard shipping is 3-5 days.
Yes, you can track all your orders. Log into your account and go to My Orders.
If your package is damaged, take photos and contact customer service. We will send a replacement.

prompt: How do I file a shipping claim?
chosen: To file a shipping claim, contact customer service with your order number and photos.

prompt: How do I return a product?
chosen: You can return a product within 30 days. Go to My Orders and select Start Return.
We accept returns within 30 days. Items must be unused in original packaging.

prompt: How long does a refund take?
chosen: Refunds take 3-5 business days after we receive your return. You will get an email confirmation.
Yes, you can exchange items. Go to My Orders and select Exchange instead of Return.
If you received the wrong item, contact customer service. We will send the correct item.

prompt: Can I return without a receipt?
chosen: You can return items without a receipt if you ordered online. We can look up your order.

prompt: Do I have to pay return shipping?
chosen: Return shipping is free for defective items. For other returns, shipping costs $6.99.

prompt: Can I return a sale item?
chosen: Yes, you can return sale items within 30 days. Final sale items cannot be returned.
If the product is defective, contact customer service with photos. We will send a replacement.

prompt: How do I print a return label?
chosen: After starting a return, you will get an email with a return label. Print it and attach to package.

prompt: Can I return to a store?
chosen: Yes, you can return items to any store. Bring the item and your order confirmation.
If your refund amount is wrong, contact customer service. We will review your order and fix it.
Yes, you can return gifts for store credit. Bring the item to a store or mail it.
Returns after 30 days are reviewed case by case. Contact customer service to request an exception.

prompt: Can I return an opened product?
chosen: You can return opened products if they are in good condition. Some items cannot be returned.

prompt: Where do I send my return?
chosen: The return address is on the return label. You will get it by email after starting a return.

prompt: Can I get a refund to a different card?
chosen: Refunds go to the original payment method. We cannot refund to a different card.
If your return was rejected, contact customer service. We will explain the reason and help you.

prompt: How do I track my return?
chosen: You can track your return with the tracking number on your return label. Check online.
You can cancel a return if you haven't shipped it yet. Contact customer service if already shipped.
Final sale items, opened hygiene products, and personalized items cannot be returned.
Yes, items must be in original packaging for returns. Keep all tags and packaging.
Yes, you can return multiple items. Select all items when starting your return.

prompt: How do I know my return was received?
chosen: You will get an email when we receive your return. Refunds are processed within 3-5 days.

prompt: Can I return items from different orders?
chosen: Each order needs a separate return. Start a return for each order in My Orders.

prompt: How do I cancel my order?
chosen: You can cancel your order within 24 hours. Go to My Orders and click Cancel Order.

prompt: Can I cancel part of my order?
chosen: Yes, you can cancel individual items. Go to My Orders and select the items to cancel.

prompt: My order already shipped, can I cancel?
chosen: You cannot cancel after shipping. You can return the item after you receive it.

prompt: Will I get a full refund if I cancel?
chosen: Yes, you will get a full refund within 3-5 business days if you cancel within 24 hours.
Cancellations are processed within 1-2 hours. You will get an email confirmation.

prompt: I canceled but was still charged
chosen: The charge will be refunded within 3-5 business days. Contact us if you don't see it.

prompt: Can I cancel a custom order?
chosen: Custom orders cannot be canceled after production starts. Contact customer service immediately.
You can cancel within 24 hours. Go to My Orders and click Cancel Order.
You can modify your order within 24 hours. Go to My Orders to make changes.

prompt: How do I know cancellation worked?
chosen: You will get an email confirmation. Check your email within 1-2 hours.
Yes, you can cancel subscriptions. Go to My Subscriptions and click Cancel.
You can cancel within 24 hours of ordering. After that, you need to return the item.

prompt: Can I cancel if it's being prepared?
chosen: If your order is being prepared, contact customer service immediately. We will try to stop it.

prompt: Will I be charged a fee?
chosen: No, there are no cancellation fees if you cancel within 24 hours.
Yes, you can cancel and place a new order. Cancel first, then order again.

prompt: What payment methods do you accept?
chosen: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and Apple Pay.

chosen: No, you can only use one payment method per order.

prompt: How do I create an account?
chosen: Click Sign Up, enter your email and password. You will get a verification email.
Click Forgot Password and enter your email. You will get a reset link.

prompt: How do I update my email?
chosen: Go to Account Settings and enter your new email. You will need to verify it.
Yes, you can delete your account in Privacy Settings. Your data will be removed.

prompt: How do I update my address?
chosen: Go to Address Book in your account. You can add or edit addresses there.

prompt: Can I save my payment info?
chosen: Yes, you can save payment methods in your account. They are stored securely.

prompt: How do I view order history?
chosen: Log into your account and go to My Orders. You will see all your past orders.
Yes, you can checkout as a guest. You don't need an account to order.
Click Unsubscribe at the bottom of any email. You can also manage preferences in your account.

prompt: Do you have a mobile app?
chosen: Yes, we have a mobile app. Download it from the App Store or Google Play.
